first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark blue-black long gun-like weapon in the lower-right foreground, with a box-shaped body, a wide flat top cover, and silver-gray edging.

entities.name: layered rock wall
entities.identification: The greenish-brown rock walls enclosing the narrow passage, with horizontally undulating layered bands, mottled textures, and protruding angular corners.

entities.name: gray-green passage floor
entities.identification: The gray-green floor extending between the rock walls on both sides toward the distant steps, with light yellow bright areas in places.

entities.name: light blue stairway entrance
entities.identification: The building entrance area at the far end of the passage, formed by light blue angular wall surfaces around the reddish-brown steps.

entities.name: reddish-brown steps
entities.identification: The short, straight flight of reddish-brown steps inside the light blue stairway entrance, connecting the passage floor to a higher platform.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The slender figure in dark clothing and pants at the top of the steps, with the arm on the image-left side bent up beside the head.
